description:
Get climate observations (temperature, precipitation, snow, wind) from NOAA.
Requires dataset ID + date range. Optionally filter by station or location.
With a station_id this also works without NOAA_API_KEY (via NOAA's keyless Access Data Service); location_id needs the key.

datatype_id.description: Data type: TMAX, TMIN, TAVG, PRCP, SNOW, SNWD, AWND

name: noaa_climate_data
